title: Strike main config
description:
JSON Schema for ~/.strike/config and ./.strike/config (and managed-config). Strike loads JSON or JSONC and ignores top-level $schema at runtime (no network fetch). Programmatic saves rewrite pure JSON and drop comments/$schema — see docs/config.md.

additionalProperties policy: true at the root and on nested objects. Runtime encoding/json ignores unknown keys; the schema stays permissive so future keys and editor-only fields do not fail validation. Known high-traffic keys are documented for autocomplete; this is best-effort alignment with internal/product/config.Config, not perfect 1:1 codegen.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint. Ignored by Strike at load (no fetch).

provider.description: Default provider id (e.g. anthropic, openai, xai, google, echo, or a custom slug).

model.description: Default model id for the provider.

systemPrompt.description: User system prompt. Replaces the provider overlay (mode=overlay, default) or shared+provider defaults (mode=defaults). Whitespace-only is ignored. Custom agent persona bodies win over this when that agent is selected.

systemPromptMode.description: How systemPrompt composes with builtins: overlay (replace provider slot only; default) or defaults (replace shared+provider; tools/env/instructions stay).

leanCode.description: Lean-code guidance intensity. Empty means lite.

deferTools.description: Defer non-core tool schemas until toolsearch. Empty means on.

theme.description: TUI theme id (bundled or under themes/). Empty means strike.

nanoMode.description: How /nano presents nano (same values as vimMode).

notify.description: Desktop notifications (OSC 9 + bell). Empty means unfocused-only.

autoupdate.description: Startup GitHub Releases check. Empty means notify. auto is opt-in binary replace when writable; never the default.

permissionAutoApproveSeconds.description: Auto-allow permission asks after N seconds (1–60). Zero disables.

permissionMode.description: Default tool-permission posture for new sessions.

sandbox.description: OS process sandbox dial for bash. Empty means workspace-write.

sandboxAllowDegrade.description: When true, permit bash to run unsandboxed if the OS backend is missing. Default false is fail-closed (sandbox_denied).

bashSecrets.description: Map of env var names to secret refs (secret://env/NAME) injected into bash tool processes only.

permissions.description: Ordered permission rules (last-match-wins within the config layer stack).

permissionPreset.description: Shipped named ruleset inserted after defaults and before permissions[].

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks: declarative action rules and/or shell commands.

providers.description: Custom/self-hosted provider endpoints (API keys live in auth.json, not here). Prefer providers.jsonc for overlays.

disable-default-providers.description: When true, hide all builtin catalog providers (customs remain).

compactionStrategy.description: Context compaction strategy. Empty/unknown ignored; default trim.

compactionModel.description: Optional model id for summarize compaction (same provider as session).

compactionThreshold.description: Occupancy fraction (0–1 exclusive of 0) that triggers compaction. Zero = engine default 0.70; >=1 disables.

compactionBuffer.description: Extra token headroom with MaxTokens. Zero = engine default 4096.

keepUserTurns.description: Trailing real user turns to preserve when compacting. Zero = engine default 2.

pruneProtectTokens.description: Recent tool-output tokens kept intact during prune. Zero = engine default 40000.

pruneMinimumTokens.description: Minimum tokens freed before prune mutates history. Zero = engine default 20000.

pruneKeepUserTurns.description: Skip tool results inside the most recent N user turns during prune. Zero = engine default 2.

pruneProtectTools.description: Extra tool names whose results stay available after prune (merged with built-in skill).

maxChildDepth.description: Nested task spawn bound (root depth 0). Zero = engine default 1; values above 8 clamp to 8.

keybinds.description: Remap app-level binding ids to key sequence(s). Prefer keybinds.jsonc. Unknown ids fail Load.

harnesses.description: Named external function harness subprocesses. Project replaces global by name.

^disable-default-[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$.description: Per-builtin provider disable (disable-default-<name>). Explicit false re-enables when disable-default-providers is true.

network.description: Application-layer egress allowlist for webfetch/websearch API hosts (not bash OS network).

allow.description: Hostnames, *.wildcard single-label, IP literals, or CIDRs. Empty/omitted = unrestricted public hosts (SSRF private blocks still apply).

contentGuard.description: Write-time content scanner on edit/write/apply_patch/notebook_edit. Distinct from egress redaction (pkg/redact). Default: credential shapes deny; high-confidence dangerous sinks ask. Error code content_guard_denied.

mode.description: off | default | ask | deny. Empty means default.

pathAllow.description: Doublestar globs over workspace-relative paths that skip the guard (e.g. **/testdata/**).

webSearch.description: Backend for the websearch tool (discover titles/URLs/snippets; use webfetch for full pages). Empty provider auto-selects brave when its API key env is set.

provider.description: Search backend id. Currently brave. Empty = auto-detect from API key env.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the API key (default BRAVE_API_KEY for brave).

baseURL.description: Optional API origin override (default https://api.search.brave.com for brave).

permission.description: Tool/permission name or * (e.g. bash, write, webfetch).

pattern.description: Glob over the ask pattern; * for any.

hook.description: Exactly one of action (declarative) or command (shell) should be set.

event.description: Lifecycle vocabulary v1: session_start|session_resume|session_end|turn_start|turn_end|provider_attempt|provider_retry|permission_resolution|compaction|phase_transition|child_lifecycle|verification_gate|pre_tool_use|post_tool_use. Shell hooks may observe all; block only on pre_tool_use.

matcher.description: Doublestar glob over tool name; empty matches all.

action.description: Declarative rule action (mutually exclusive with command).

message.description: Optional text for block/notify declarative rules.

command.description: Shell hook via bash -c; event JSON on stdin.

failClosed.description: Shell hook failure policy for timeout/launch/process errors. Default fail-closed on pre/post_tool_use; true forces closed, false forces open (availability).

name.description: Lowercase slug; must not collide with built-in provider names.

baseURL.description: Absolute http(s) URL or env placeholder ({env:NAME}, $NAME, ${NAME}).

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name holding the API key (not the secret itself).

keybindChords.description: One key sequence or a list of sequences.

session.description: Per-session runtime preferences (worktree isolation, retention, timeline/trace bounds, agent budget).

worktree.description: Session worktree isolation. Empty means off.

worktreeCleanup.description: On session close. Empty means keep.

overlapPolicy.description: Multi-agent path conflict policy. Empty means warn.

retentionMaxAgeDays.description: Delete closed sessions older than N days (0 = off).

retentionMaxBytes.description: Cap total closed session log+meta bytes (0 = off).

timelineMaxEntries.description: In-memory structured run timeline cap (0 = library default).

timelineArgsPreviewMax.description: Inline args preview rune cap (0 = default 512).

timelineOutputPreviewMax.description: Inline output preview rune cap (0 = default 2048).

timelineBlobSpill.description: Spill oversized redacted tool payloads under ~/.strike/traces/<sessionId>/blobs/.

traceRetentionMaxFiles.description: Bound ~/.strike/traces and runs trees by file count (0 = unlimited).

traceRetentionMaxAgeDays.description: Bound traces/runs by age in days (0 = unlimited).

traceRetentionMaxBytes.description: Bound traces/runs by total bytes (0 = unlimited).

maxSessionCostUSD.description: Outer session cost envelope in USD (#577). Zero = unlimited. Enforced when catalog pricing is available.

maxTurnTokens.description: Per-turn accumulated stream token ceiling (#577). Zero = unlimited.

turnTimeoutS.description: Root-turn wall-clock deadline in seconds. 0/omitted = default 1800 (30m). Negative disables. Fresh per turn; resume does not inherit an expired deadline.

childIsolation.description: Default filesystem mode for task children. Empty/off/shared = parent workdir. worktree = per-child git worktree with inspectable patch on complete.

auditRetentionMaxEvents.description: Max security audit sink events under ~/.strike/audit/ (0 = default 10000 when both audit axes unset).

auditRetentionMaxAgeDays.description: Delete audit events older than N days (0 = default 90 when both audit axes unset).

agentBudget.description: Default per-child resource limits for task spawns. Zero = unlimited for that dimension.

delegationPolicy.description: Pre-spawn delegation-worthiness gate (#876). When omitted, the CLI defaults mode to enforce.

mode.description: off = always spawn; advise = record preferred action but spawn; enforce = soft-local returns status local; hard ceilings deny.

tinyPromptRunes.description: Bare prompts at or below this rune count prefer local (0 → 280).

maxPathsLocal.description: Bare tasks with ≤N context_bundle paths prefer local (0 → 1; negative disables).

maxLiveChildren.description: Hard-deny when live children reach this count (0 = unlimited).

admission.description: Register/load-time admission scans for MCP servers, skills, and plugins. Distinct from permissionPreset and OS sandbox. See docs/admission.md.

preset.description: Severity→action matrix. Empty means default. strict fails closed on scanner errors.

allowPaths.description: Home-anchored path prefixes trusted as first-party (~/… or absolute under $HOME). Bare relative markers are rejected (spoofable).

failClosed.description: When true, scanner errors become block. Defaults true for strict, false otherwise.

mcp.description: MCP servers. Prefer mcp.jsonc; when a layer sets servers (including {}), it replaces the previous map.

container.description: Native containerization (E12). Also loadable from container.jsonc/json. Merge: defaults → global → project → managed. See docs/config.md and docs/container.md.

dockerfile.description: Optional path to a hand-written Dockerfile (relative to repo or absolute).

execution.description: Where the agent runs: local (default) or container (E12.4).

engine.description: Container CLI binary override (docker, podman, or absolute path).

needsNode.description: Install Node.js via NodeSource in the generated Dockerfile (E12.5).

nodeVersion.description: Node major version for NodeSource setup (default 22).

needsPython.description: Install Python via apt in the generated Dockerfile (E12.5).

pythonVersion.description: Python version suffix for apt packages (default 3).

needsGo.description: Install golang-go and build deps in the generated Dockerfile (E12.5).

goVersion.description: Informational go.mod version recorded in the Dockerfile comment.

needsRust.description: Install Rust via rustup in the generated Dockerfile (E12.5).

containerNetwork.description: Container network posture. allow reuses the network.allow host/CIDR shape for future egress filters.

mcpServer.description: stdio command or streamable HTTP URL. Empty type with url set implies http.

cwd.description: Stdio subprocess working directory. Empty inherits the process launch directory. Plugin-sourced Agent Plugins servers set this to the plugin root or an expanded PLUGIN_DATA path.

mcpOAuth.description: Optional OAuth for HTTP MCP (discovery, refresh, revoke). Tokens never logged.

lsp.description: Language servers (JSON-RPC over stdio). Layer servers map replaces previous (including {}).

diagnosticsSeverity.description: Minimum severity injected into file-tool results. Default error.

extensions.description: File extensions this server handles (e.g. .go). Required at start.

mode.description: Process lifecycle: oneshot (default) or persistent worker reuse.

maxConcurrent.description: Max in-flight invocations on one persistent worker (default 1).

idleTimeoutMs.description: Idle shutdown for persistent workers in ms (default 60000; negative disables).

maxRestarts.description: Crash recovery budget for persistent workers (default 3; negative unlimited).

scheduler.description: In-process resource pool limits and command classification (one OS process only).

limits.description: Pool name → positive capacity. Omitted = unlimited. Explicit 0 fails load.

toolRetry.description: Harness error-recovery / retry policy for tool dispatch.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per tool call including first. Zero = default 3; 1 disables auto-retry.

baseDelayMs.description: First backoff step in ms. Zero = default 200.

maxDelayMs.description: Backoff cap in ms. Zero = default 2000.

loopThreshold.description: Identical consecutive failing tool+args before turn stops. Zero = default 3.
